heard: A cosmic wall of galaxies stretches across the sky. If our home galaxy were a pebble, this is a mountain. It contains thousands of galaxies across 500 million light years. Astronomers Margaret Geller and John Hughcra mapped this sheet. They used a 60-inch telescope in Arizona in 1989. Gravity alone is far too slow to weave together such a massive structure. It proves a hidden web of dark matter must be pulling the strings. Our own Milky Way still hides where it ends. A hidden giant still stretches across the sky.
